question_vi: Interceptor trong Retrofit/OkHttp là gì và cách dùng?
question_en: What are Interceptors in Retrofit/OkHttp and how do you use them?
answer_vi:
Interceptor chặn HTTP request/response để chỉnh sửa chúng.

```kotlin
OkHttpClient.Builder()
    .addInterceptor { chain ->
        val request = chain.request().newBuilder()
            .addHeader("Authorization", token)
            .build()
        chain.proceed(request)
    }
    .build()
```

- Application interceptor chạy một lần cho mỗi request; network interceptor chạy cho từng lần gọi network thực tế (kể cả redirect và retry).
- Dùng phổ biến: gắn auth header, log request/response, xử lý refresh token, cache.
answer_en:
Interceptors sit in front of HTTP requests and responses so you can modify them.

```kotlin
OkHttpClient.Builder()
    .addInterceptor { chain ->
        val request = chain.request().newBuilder()
            .addHeader("Authorization", token)
            .build()
        chain.proceed(request)
    }
    .build()
```

- An application interceptor runs once per request; a network interceptor runs for every actual network call, including redirects and retries.
- Common uses: attaching auth headers, logging requests/responses, handling token refresh, caching.
